definitions.K: K is the number of distinct runtime connections in an arrangement. One connection is one (from node, to node, meaning) triple of kind 'runtime' with a piece or a shared part on at least one end, backed by at least one evidence row in that arrangement's own template. K leaves out: links inside the app core (kind 'core'), a piece bringing a shared part (kind 'membership'), deploy-order links (kind 'deploy-order'), deploy-time helper links (kind 'deploy-helper'), and grants on things outside the template (outsideGrants). K is a lookup by arrangement key, never a sum of single-piece counts.
definitions.carriers: Per edge, the logical ids at each end across all arrangements. A view that unfolds a piece marks the ids in carriers.from or carriers.to that belong to that piece and exist in the arrangement.
definitions.evidence: Each edge carries the rows from the smallest arrangement that has it (evidenceTemplateKey). connections.evidence.json has the rows for every arrangement.
definitions.evidenceRow: template: path from the job root. holder: the resource the property sits in. target: the resource it points at. propertyPath: JSON pointer from the holder resource. via: Ref, Fn::GetAtt, Fn::Sub, DependsOn, literal-name (a plain string equal to a name the template assigns), wildcard (an IAM pattern that covers the target's type), service-principal (a trust statement naming the target's service), exists (membership). principal: the role a policy is attached to. addedToBaseline: the holder is a baseline resource and this entry isn't in baseline.json.
definitions.keys: An arrangement key alone means all four standards on when it holds the custom piece. combosByStandards[arrangement][standards] holds only the fields that differ from combos[arrangement] for that standards key; merge it over the all-on entry. An empty object means nothing differs.

kinds.core: A runtime link between two parts of the app core, already in the no-pieces baseline. Not counted in K.
kinds.deploy-helper: A link to a deploy-time helper (custom resource providers, bucket deployments, log retention, index and secret setup). Not counted in K.
kinds.deploy-order: A DependsOn only: one resource is created after another. Not a runtime connection.
kinds.membership: A piece brings a shared part. Drawn as pieces touching the shared part, not counted in K.
kinds.runtime: A link the deployed app uses while it runs. Counted in K.

definitions.pairs.relation: direct: a runtime edge between the two pieces' own resources. shared: no direct edge, but both bring the named shared parts. core: neither, but both plug into the app core (commonCoreNodes, or corePath when they use different sockets). none: nothing.
